title: The bird on Box 27
logline: New Year's Eve in the garage: the bird on Box 27's lid, the last box of the year, the register line under its feet. The lamp. The page's only clock is the box number.

panels.composition: The small rainbow bird perched on the lid of a cardboard box on a stack, a pencilled line beneath its feet, the lamp's light, the garage dark beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird perched on the lid of a numbered cardboard box on a stack with a pencilled line beneath its feet in lamplight, a dark garage beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The only clock is the box number.
